strategy_statement: [engine: VALIDATE-only] One engine runs three wallet processes (per-wallet sequential salt counters, reset by the daily ~01:00 UTC restart within ~20 s of each other; real ms timestamps until ~06-21, 0 since), each signing ~11-18 orders/s. [selection: hypothesis] It quotes nearly every crypto Up/Down window of the modules it runs: BTC 5m and 15m on weekdays, BTC 4h, hourly and daily, ETH, SOL, XRP and others around the clock; BTC 5m/15m are switched off for hours, mostly from Friday-Sunday US-Eastern evenings to the next morning (calendar gate window AUC 0.68); the 10-31 16:53 switch-off was made inside the running processes (counters continuous, signing rate unchanged) and two engines were restarted ad hoc 12-13 min later. R6's universe (BTC 5m + 15m) holds >= 80% of trades and dollars in only 34% of 6-h blocks; only the all-crypto universe does in every block type. [timing: VALIDATE-only] It re-prices its ladders on each Chainlink report within ~0-150 ms of the public RTDS relay's publish, plus re-posts 50-400 ms after Binance moves; filled orders are fresh 500-share posts at the touch matched ~0.7 s later; it stops ~30 s before the end. [side: VALIDATE-only] It buys the outcome whose Chainlink edge over the Polymarket mid is positive (digital of the report stamped T - 1.432 s, Gamma strike, 1.4 x 300-s vol): 0.79 per fill on the 10-31 match clock (0.85 where the reference and the market disagree on the favourite: an information part that needs no volatility; 0.76 where they agree and the choice is a volatility comparison), 0.78 per taker event against an own-history baseline of 0.86, 0.75 on the families nobody examined (36 fills), 0.60-0.65 on the historical block clock. A slow (~1-h) sigma fits the live fills better and the 15m quote level too (0.775 vs 0.724), but fails both pre-registered historical replications (5m and 15m VALIDATE, where 88% of fills are complement mints landing on the underdog) and does not help the 5m quote level, so it is not adopted. [price: exam-verified (block clock) / VALIDATE-only (match clock)] Fill price = last clean print minus a tick (0.83-0.86 match clock, 0.70 block clock); each ladder hangs off its own market's mid with a ~0.2 Chainlink skew, and its depth follows the digital's risk only partly (R^2 0.47). [size: VALIDATE-only] 500 x 2^k shares in the weekday session or high vol, 62/250 otherwise. [exit: VALIDATE-only] Holds to resolution; small complement merges. [economics: VALIDATE-only] Profit is concentrated in cheap underdog fills when the reference and the market agree (BUILD: 73% of PnL on 13% of dollars) and in fills on the reference's side when they disagree; it is a liquidity provider skewed by the settlement stream, paid by takers who buy favourites through complement mints.
